interface.title: Rainfall Verification Dashboard
interface.field: Meteorology / numerical weather prediction (precipitation forecast verification)
interface.stage_of_work: Evaluation: checking model forecasts against gridded observations once both exist
interface.what_it_is_for: Scoring gridded rainfall forecasts (per lead time, one or several models) against a gridded observation file over a region the user picks on a map, with categorical, continuous and spatial scores, per-cell score maps, bootstrap confidence intervals and exports.

data.note: The sidebar's Server folder paths come pre-filled with the bundled demo: /work/app/demo_data (ModelA and ModelB folders, leads 1–3; loose files directly in the folder show as a third model, '· (files in this folder)') and /work/app/demo_data/obs_demo.nc (2020-06-01 to 2020-06-30, roughly 70–90°E, 8–30°N). Neither file has a units attribute, so the app assumes mm and says so in the sidebar. ModelA and ModelB are deterministic; the early runs left Forecast type at Ensemble (Mean), which on these files is in effect deterministic verification, not verification of an ensemble mean. The reviewer reports from the app's docs (docs/DEMO_DATA.md) that '· (files in this folder)' is a bundled 15-member ensemble (day01–05fcst_demo.nc, leads 1–5). This run removed that model from the list and never verified it, so probabilistic verification was not reached; it was not blocked by the data.
